nodes.npc: Hi there! What can I get you?
nodes.npcZh: 嗨！要點什麼呢？

replies.en: Can I have a cup of tea, please?
I'd like a hot chocolate, please.
Give me tea.
replies.correction: Can I have a cup of tea, please?
replies.explain: 「Give me tea.」是命令句，對店員說聽起來很沒禮貌。點餐可以說 Can I have...? 或 I'd like...，最後加上 please。

nodes.npc: Sure. Small or large?
nodes.npcZh: 好的，小杯還是大杯？

replies.en: A small one is fine.
Large, please. I'm really thirsty.

nodes.npc: One small tea. That's two dollars.
nodes.npcZh: 一杯小杯茶，兩塊錢。

replies.en: OK, thank you.

nodes.npc: One large tea. That's three dollars.
nodes.npcZh: 一杯大杯茶，三塊錢。

replies.en: Sounds good. Thanks.

nodes.npc: Nice choice! Would you like some cream on top?
nodes.npcZh: 好選擇！上面要加一些奶油嗎？

replies.en: Yes, please. That sounds great.
Yes, I very like cream on my drink.
replies.zh: 好，我很喜歡飲料加奶油。

reaction.en: Ha, you like it a lot? OK, cream it is!
reaction.zh: 哈，你很喜歡對吧？好，幫你加奶油！

replies.correction: Yes, please. I really like cream.
replies.explain: 英文不說 I very like...。very 不能直接修飾動詞，要說 I really like... 或 I like it very much。

nodes.npc: Is that for here or to go?
nodes.npcZh: 內用還是外帶？

replies.en: For here. I'll sit by the window.
To go, please. I'm in a hurry.

nodes.npc: Sure. I'll bring it to your table.
nodes.npcZh: 好，我會送到你的座位。

replies.en: Thank you. How much is it?

nodes.npc: No problem. I'll put a lid on it for you.
nodes.npcZh: 沒問題，我幫你蓋上杯蓋。

replies.en: Great, thanks. How much is it?

nodes.npc: It's on the screen here. Cash or card?
nodes.npcZh: 金額在螢幕上。付現還是刷卡？

replies.en: Card, please.
replies.note: 最簡短的說法，結帳時很常用。

replies.en: I'll pay by card.
replies.note: 完整一點的說法，語氣一樣自然。

nodes.npc: Thanks! Here's your drink. Have a nice day!
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝！這是你的飲料，祝你有美好的一天！

replies.en: Thanks. You too!

nodes.npc: Hi! What would you like today?
nodes.npcZh: 嗨！今天想喝點什麼？

replies.en: Could I get an iced latte, please?
replies.zh: 可以給我一杯冰拿鐵嗎？

replies.en: I'm not sure yet. What's popular here?
replies.zh: 我還沒決定，這裡什麼比較受歡迎？

nodes.npc: Our honey latte is a big hit. It's sweet, but not too sweet.
nodes.npcZh: 我們的蜂蜜拿鐵很受歡迎，甜但不會太甜。

replies.en: Sounds great. I'll have a hot one, please.
replies.zh: 聽起來很棒，我要一杯熱的。

nodes.npc: Sure. Do you want regular ice or less ice?
nodes.npcZh: 好的，要正常冰還是少冰？

replies.en: Less ice, please. I don't like it too cold.
Fewer ice, please.

reaction.en: Fewer ice? Oh, you mean less ice. Got it!
reaction.zh: Fewer ice？喔，你是說少冰吧，了解！

replies.explain: ice 是不可數名詞，要用 less，不能用 fewer。fewer 只接可數名詞，例如 fewer cups。

nodes.npc: Would you like regular milk or oat milk?
nodes.npcZh: 要一般牛奶還是燕麥奶？

replies.en: Could I have oat milk instead?
Regular milk is fine, thanks.

nodes.npc: Sure. Oat milk is fifteen dollars extra. Is that OK?
nodes.npcZh: 好的，燕麥奶要加十五元，可以嗎？

replies.en: That's fine. It's worth it.

nodes.npc: Got it. One latte with regular milk.
nodes.npcZh: 了解，一杯一般牛奶的拿鐵。

replies.en: Thanks. Do you have anything to eat?

nodes.npc: Our banana bread just came out of the oven. Want a slice?
nodes.npcZh: 香蕉蛋糕剛出爐，要來一片嗎？

replies.en: Yes, please! It smells amazing.
No, thanks. I just had lunch.
replies.zh: 不用，謝謝，我剛吃完午餐。

nodes.npc: Great. Do you want it warmed up?
nodes.npcZh: 好，要幫你加熱嗎？

replies.en: Yes, please. I like it warm.
Yes, please warm up it.

reaction.en: Warm it up? Sure, no problem.

replies.explain: 代名詞 it 當片語動詞的受詞時要放中間：warm it up，不能說 warm up it。

nodes.npc: No problem. Maybe next time!
nodes.npcZh: 沒問題，下次再試試！

replies.en: Sure. I'll try it next time.

nodes.npc: Your total is on the screen. You can tap your card here.
nodes.npcZh: 金額在螢幕上，可以在這裡感應卡片。

replies.en: Sure. Here you go.

nodes.npc: Thanks! I'll call your name when it's ready.
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝！好了會叫你的名字。

replies.en: Great. I'll wait over there.

scenarios.title: A mix-up, Wi-Fi, and a chat

nodes.npc: Hi there! Is everything all right with your order?
nodes.npcZh: 嗨！你的餐點還好嗎？

replies.en: Sorry to bother you, but I don't think this is what I ordered.
replies.zh: 不好意思打擾，但這好像不是我點的。
replies.note: 先道歉再說明問題，語氣客氣委婉。

replies.en: Excuse me, I think I got the wrong drink.
replies.zh: 不好意思，我好像拿錯飲料了。
replies.note: 直接點出問題，Excuse me 和 I think 讓語氣保持禮貌。

nodes.npc: Oh no, I'm sorry about that. What did you order?
nodes.npcZh: 喔不，真抱歉。你原本點的是什麼？

replies.en: I ordered an iced latte, but this one's hot.
replies.zh: 我點的是冰拿鐵，但這杯是熱的。
replies.note: 清楚對比點的和拿到的，最常見的說法。

replies.en: It was supposed to be an iced latte.
replies.zh: 這杯本來應該是冰拿鐵。
replies.note: be supposed to 表示「本來應該是」，委婉地說明出錯。

nodes.npc: Thanks for letting me know. Would you like us to remake it, or would you prefer a refund?
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝你告訴我。要幫你重做，還是你比較想退款？

replies.en: Could you remake it as an iced one, please?
replies.zh: 可以幫我重做一杯冰的嗎？

replies.en: Actually, I'd rather just get a refund.
replies.zh: 其實我比較想直接退款。

nodes.npc: Absolutely. It'll be ready in a few minutes. Anything else I can help you with while you wait?
nodes.npcZh: 當然，幾分鐘就好。等待時還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

replies.en: Actually, yes. Is there Wi-Fi here?
replies.zh: 其實有，這裡有 Wi-Fi 嗎？

nodes.npc: Of course. The refund should show up on your card in a few days. Is there anything else I can do for you?
nodes.npcZh: 好的，退款幾天內會回到你的卡上。還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

replies.en: Yes, actually. Could I use the Wi-Fi before I head out?
replies.zh: 有，我離開前可以用一下 Wi-Fi 嗎？

nodes.npc: Sure! The network is LittleTown Guest, and the password is on your receipt. So, are you new to the neighborhood?
nodes.npcZh: 可以！網路是 LittleTown Guest，密碼在收據上。對了，你是剛來這附近嗎？

replies.en: Yes, I'm just exploring the area. Any places you'd recommend?
replies.zh: 對，我正在逛這一帶。有推薦的地方嗎？

replies.en: Not really. I study nearby, so I come here between classes.
replies.zh: 不算是，我在附近讀書，常在課堂之間來這裡。

nodes.npc: Definitely check out the park by the river. It's beautiful this time of year.
nodes.npcZh: 一定要去河邊的公園看看，這個季節很美。

replies.en: Thanks, I'll definitely check it out.
replies.note: 最常見的回應，表示會去看看。

replies.en: That sounds lovely. I'll put it on my list.
replies.zh: 聽起來很棒，我會把它列入清單。
replies.note: put it on my list 表示「列入清單」，語氣輕鬆友善。

nodes.npc: Oh, nice! Then I'll probably see you around. What are you studying?
nodes.npcZh: 喔，不錯！那之後應該常會見到你。你讀什麼科系？

replies.en: Environmental science. It keeps me pretty busy.

nodes.npc: Well, it was nice chatting with you. Sorry again about the mix-up!
nodes.npcZh: 很高興跟你聊天，飲料弄錯再次抱歉！

replies.en: No worries at all. Thanks for sorting it out.
replies.zh: 完全沒關係，謝謝你幫忙處理。
replies.note: No worries 輕鬆表示「沒關係」，sort out 是「處理好」。

replies.en: It's totally fine. I appreciate your help.
replies.zh: 真的沒關係，謝謝你的幫忙。
replies.note: 比較完整、稍微正式一點的感謝。

scenarios.title: Coffee for the team
scenarios.titleZh: 同事外帶、發票與等待處理

nodes.npc: Good morning! What can I get started for you?
nodes.npcZh: 早安！今天想點些什麼？

replies.en: I'm picking up drinks for my team: two lattes and two black coffees, all to go.
replies.zh: 我要幫同事外帶：兩杯拿鐵、兩杯黑咖啡。
replies.note: 先說明用途再列品項，店員容易掌握。

replies.en: Could I get four drinks to go? Two lattes and two black coffees.
replies.zh: 可以外帶四杯嗎？兩杯拿鐵、兩杯黑咖啡。
replies.note: 先講總數再細分，點大量飲料時很清楚。

nodes.npc: Sure thing. Should I make all four large?
nodes.npcZh: 沒問題。四杯都做大杯嗎？

replies.en: Yes, all large, please. And could you label the cups?
replies.zh: 對，都大杯。可以在杯子上標示嗎？
replies.note: 一次提出兩個需求，簡潔有效率。

replies.en: Large is perfect. Would you mind labeling each cup, too?
replies.zh: 大杯剛好。可以麻煩也在每個杯子上標示嗎？
replies.note: Would you mind...? 是更客氣的請求方式。

nodes.npc: Of course. Would you like a regular receipt or a company invoice?
nodes.npcZh: 當然。你需要一般收據，還是公司發票？

replies.en: A company invoice, please. Our tax ID is 12345675.
A regular receipt is fine. This one's on me.
replies.zh: 一般收據就好，這次我請客。

nodes.npc: I've added the tax ID. Could you double-check the number on the screen?
nodes.npcZh: 統編已經打上了，可以確認一下螢幕上的號碼嗎？

replies.en: Yes, that's correct. I'll pay by card.

nodes.npc: That's very generous of you! I'll put the receipt in the bag.
nodes.npcZh: 你真大方！我會把收據放進袋子裡。

replies.en: Thanks. I'll pay by card, please.

nodes.npc: I'm sorry, we're a bit backed up right now. It'll be about fifteen minutes.
nodes.npcZh: 不好意思，現在訂單有點多，大約要十五分鐘。

replies.en: We have a meeting at nine. Could you make the black coffees first?
replies.zh: 我們九點要開會，可以先做黑咖啡嗎？

replies.en: That's fine. Could you deliver them to our office next door?
replies.zh: 沒關係。可以送到隔壁的辦公室嗎？

nodes.npc: Sure. The black coffees will be ready in two minutes, and the lattes will follow shortly.
nodes.npcZh: 可以，黑咖啡兩分鐘就好，拿鐵隨後送上。

replies.en: That works for us. Thanks for being flexible.
replies.zh: 這樣可以，謝謝你們彈性配合。
replies.note: That works 表示方案可行，簡潔常用。

replies.en: Perfect. I really appreciate you making that happen.
replies.zh: 太好了，真的很感謝你們幫忙安排。
replies.note: 語氣更熱情，強調感謝對方配合。

nodes.npc: We can do that. Which floor are you on?
nodes.npcZh: 可以。你們在幾樓？

replies.en: We're on the fifth floor. Just ask for the marketing team at the front desk.
replies.zh: 我們在五樓，到櫃檯說找行銷部就可以。

nodes.npc: Got it. Thanks for your patience!
nodes.npcZh: 了解，謝謝你的耐心！

replies.en: Thanks for helping us work around the delay.
replies.zh: 謝謝你幫我們因應等候的狀況。
replies.note: work around 是「設法因應」，職場常用。

replies.en: No problem. Thanks for accommodating us.
replies.zh: 沒問題，謝謝你們的配合。
replies.note: accommodate 表示「配合、通融」，語氣較正式。
